_comment: Fully fixture-scripted (no real LLM call, no setup.sql) -- exercises the MID-TURN half of per-task tool resolution (docs/components/tool-registry.md, 'Resolved: Three-Layer Tool Taxonomy & Per-Task Resolution'). A scripted response's tool_calls still dispatch for REAL (fixtures only script the model's own text/tool_calls, never the handler), so search_tools' real handler runs and tools._persist_discovered should write whatever it found into turn_retrieval under THIS turn's own id -- the same table ToolDiscover's pre-turn scan writes to, and the same one prompt.assemble/tools_schema_for re-read fresh on the turn's next ModelCall. That's what lets the model invoke a mid-turn discovery by name on its next step now that call_tool is no longer in its schema at all. Pre-seeding this via setup.sql was tried and reverted: turns.status only allows running/completed/cancelled/failed (no neutral 'not started yet' value), and cmd/starter treats any pre-existing status='running' row as an ALREADY-ACTIVE turn, routing the scenario's message as a follow-up instead of a fresh turn start -- so seeding happens for real, mid-turn, via the tool call itself instead.
